mapper.update: update research_record set current_phase=#{phase}, status=#{status} where record_id=#{recordId}
mapper.select: select * from research_record where record_id=#{recordId}
mapper.update: update research_proposal set status=#{status}, submitted_at=case when #{status}='UNDER_REVIEW' then now() else submitted_at end, approved_at=case when #{status}='APPROVED' then now() else approved_at end, rejected_at=case when #{status}='REJECTED' then now() else rejected_at end, version=version+1 where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.select: select p.proposal_id proposalId,p.record_id recordId,p.call_id callId,p.proposal_no proposalNo,p.title, p.applicant_user_id applicantUserId,p.applicant_dept_id applicantDeptId,p.background,p.objectives,p.project_scope projectScope,p.out_of_scope outOfScope, p.research_content researchContent,p.methodology,p.innovation_points innovationPoints,p.success_criteria successCriteria,p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate, p.requested_budget requestedBudget,p.status,p.version,p.submitted_at submittedAt,p.approved_at approvedAt,p.create_time createTime, u.nick_name applicantName,d.dept_name deptName,r.record_no recordNo,r.current_phase currentPhase from research_proposal p join research_record r on r.record_id=p.record_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.applicant_dept_id where p.proposal_id=#{proposalId}

select p.proposal_id proposalId,p.record_id recordId,p.proposal_no proposalNo,p.title,p.status,p.requested_budget requestedBudget,p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate, p.applicant_user_id applicantUserId,u.nick_name applicantName,d.dept_name deptName,p.update_time updateTime, (select count(*) from research_document doc where doc.business_type='PROPOSAL' and doc.business_id=p.proposal_id and doc.status='ACTIVE') documentCount from research_proposal p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.applicant_dept_id
p.applicant_user_id=#{userId} and p.status=#{status} and (p.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.proposal_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.update_time desc,p.proposal_id desc
select count(*) from research_proposal_member where proposal_id=#{proposalId}

select m.member_id memberId,m.user_id userId,m.member_role memberRole,m.responsibility,m.planned_allocation plannedAllocation,u.nick_name userName from research_proposal_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by m.sort_order,m.member_id
select budget_line_id budgetLineId,category,amount,description,sort_order sortOrder from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by sort_order,budget_line_id
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId}

select expected_output_id expectedOutputId,output_type outputType,name,target_quantity targetQuantity,target_description targetDescription from research_expected_output where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.update: update research_review set reviewer_user_id=#{reviewerId},decision=#{decision},comment=#{comment},status='COMPLETED',completed_at=now() where proposal_id=#{proposalId} and status='PENDING'
mapper.select: select r.review_id reviewId,r.review_type reviewType,r.reviewer_user_id reviewerUserId,u.nick_name reviewerName,r.score,r.decision,r.comment,r.status,r.started_at startedAt,r.completed_at completedAt from research_review r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.reviewer_user_id where r.proposal_id=#{proposalId} order by r.review_id

select award_id awardId,record_id recordId,proposal_id proposalId,award_no awardNo,approved_title approvedTitle,approved_start_date approvedStartDate,approved_end_date approvedEndDate,approved_budget approvedBudget,approved_scope approvedScope,approved_objectives approvedObjectives,approved_outputs approvedOutputs,status,issued_at issuedAt from research_award where proposal_id=#{proposalId}

select award_id awardId,record_id recordId,proposal_id proposalId,award_no awardNo,approved_title approvedTitle,approved_start_date approvedStartDate,approved_end_date approvedEndDate,approved_budget approvedBudget,approved_scope approvedScope,approved_objectives approvedObjectives,approved_outputs approvedOutputs,status from research_award where award_id=#{awardId}
mapper.update: update research_project set status=#{status},activated_at=case when #{status}='ACTIVE' and activated_at is null then now() else activated_at end,closing_at=case when #{status}='CLOSING' then now() else closing_at end,closed_at=case when #{status}='CLOSED' then now() else closed_at end,version=version+1 where project_id=#{projectId}

update research_project set current_baseline_id=#{baselineId},status=#{status},activated_at=case when #{status}='ACTIVE' and activated_at is null then now() else activated_at end,version=version+1 where project_id=#{projectId}

update research_project p set p.progress=(select coalesce(round(avg(w.progress)),0) from research_work_item w where w.project_id=p.project_id and w.item_type in ('TASK','MILESTONE')) where p.project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.select: select p.project_id projectId,p.record_id recordId,p.proposal_id proposalId,p.award_id awardId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,p.pi_user_id piUserId, p.dept_id deptId,p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,p.current_budget currentBudget,p.current_baseline_id currentBaselineId,p.progress,p.status,p.version, p.activated_at activatedAt,p.closed_at closedAt,u.nick_name piName,d.dept_name deptName,r.record_no recordNo, a.award_no awardNo,a.approved_scope approvedScope,a.approved_objectives approvedObjectives,a.approved_outputs approvedOutputs from research_project p join research_record r on r.record_id=p.record_id join research_award a on a.award_id=p.award_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.pi_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.dept_id where p.project_id=#{projectId}

select p.project_id projectId,p.record_id recordId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,p.pi_user_id piUserId,u.nick_name piName,d.dept_name deptName, p.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,p.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,p.current_budget currentBudget,p.progress,p.status,p.update_time updateTime, coalesce((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.project_id=p.project_id),0) usedBudget, (select count(*) from research_risk r where r.project_id=p.project_id and r.status not in ('CLOSED')) openRiskCount, (select count(*) from research_issue i where i.project_id=p.project_id and i.status not in ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')) openIssueCount from research_project p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.pi_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.dept_id
and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId} and pm.status='ACTIVE')) and p.status=#{status} and (p.project_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.project_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.update_time desc,p.project_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into research_project_member(project_id,user_id,member_role,responsibility,allocation_percent,join_date,status,create_by) select #{projectId},user_id,member_role,responsibility,planned_allocation,curdate(),'ACTIVE',#{username} from research_proposal_member where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
mapper.select: select m.member_id memberId,m.user_id userId,m.member_role memberRole,m.responsibility,m.allocation_percent allocationPercent,m.status,u.nick_name userName from research_project_member m left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id where m.project_id=#{projectId} order by m.member_id
select count(*) from research_project_member where project_id=#{projectId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE'
select member_role from research_project_member where project_id=#{projectId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' limit 1

select work_item_id workItemId,project_id projectId,parent_id parentId,item_type itemType,wbs_code wbsCode,title,description,owner_user_id ownerUserId,planned_start_date plannedStartDate,planned_end_date plannedEndDate,actual_start_date actualStartDate,actual_end_date actualEndDate,weight,progress,status,priority,sort_order sortOrder from research_work_item where work_item_id=#{workItemId}

select w.work_item_id workItemId,w.project_id projectId,w.parent_id parentId,w.item_type itemType,w.wbs_code wbsCode,w.title,w.description,w.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,w.planned_start_date plannedStartDate,w.planned_end_date plannedEndDate,w.actual_start_date actualStartDate,w.actual_end_date actualEndDate,w.weight,w.progress,w.status,w.priority,w.sort_order sortOrder from research_work_item w left join sys_user u on u.user_id=w.owner_user_id where w.project_id=#{projectId} order by w.sort_order,w.work_item_id
mapper.update: update research_work_item set status=#{status},progress=#{progress},actual_start_date=case when #{status}='IN_PROGRESS' and actual_start_date is null then curdate() else actual_start_date end,actual_end_date=case when #{status}='DONE' then curdate() else actual_end_date end,update_by=#{username},version=version+1 where work_item_id=#{workItemId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from research_work_item where project_id=#{projectId}
select count(*) from research_work_item where project_id=#{projectId} and item_type in ('TASK','MILESTONE') and status<>'DONE'

select r.report_id reportId,r.report_no reportNo,r.report_type reportType,r.period_start periodStart,r.period_end periodEnd,r.overall_progress overallProgress,r.completed_work completedWork,r.key_achievements keyAchievements,r.problems,r.risks,r.next_plan nextPlan,r.support_needed supportNeeded,r.budget_summary budgetSummary,r.status,r.prepared_by preparedBy,u.nick_name preparedByName,r.submitted_at submittedAt from research_progress_report r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.prepared_by where r.project_id=#{projectId} order by r.submitted_at desc,r.report_id desc

select risk_id riskId,project_id projectId,risk_no riskNo,title,description,category,probability,impact,score,risk_level riskLevel,trigger_condition triggerCondition,response_strategy responseStrategy,owner_user_id ownerUserId,source,rule_code ruleCode,status from research_risk where risk_id=#{riskId}

select r.risk_id riskId,r.project_id projectId,r.risk_no riskNo,r.title,r.description,r.category,r.probability,r.impact,r.score,r.risk_level riskLevel,r.trigger_condition triggerCondition,r.response_strategy responseStrategy,r.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,r.source,r.rule_code ruleCode,r.status,r.identified_at identifiedAt from research_risk r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.owner_user_id where r.project_id=#{projectId} order by field(r.risk_level,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'),r.risk_id desc

select r.risk_id riskId,r.project_id projectId,r.risk_no riskNo,r.title,r.description,r.risk_level riskLevel,r.score,r.status,r.source,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,u.nick_name ownerName from research_risk r join research_project p on p.project_id=r.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.owner_user_id and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId})) order by field(r.risk_level,'CRITICAL','HIGH','MEDIUM','LOW'),r.risk_id desc
mapper.update: update research_risk set status=#{status},closed_at=case when #{status}='CLOSED' then now() else closed_at end,update_by=#{username},version=version+1 where risk_id=#{riskId}
mapper.select: select issue_id issueId,project_id projectId,source_risk_id sourceRiskId,issue_no issueNo,title,description,severity,owner_user_id ownerUserId,due_date dueDate,status,resolution from research_issue where issue_id=#{issueId}

select i.issue_id issueId,i.project_id projectId,i.source_risk_id sourceRiskId,i.issue_no issueNo,i.title,i.description,i.severity,i.owner_user_id ownerUserId,u.nick_name ownerName,i.occurred_at occurredAt,i.due_date dueDate,i.status,i.resolution from research_issue i left join sys_user u on u.user_id=i.owner_user_id where i.project_id=#{projectId} order by i.issue_id desc

select i.issue_id issueId,i.project_id projectId,i.issue_no issueNo,i.title,i.description,i.severity,i.status,i.due_date dueDate,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,u.nick_name ownerName from research_issue i join research_project p on p.project_id=i.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=i.owner_user_id and (p.pi_user_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from research_project_member pm where pm.project_id=p.project_id and pm.user_id=#{userId})) order by i.issue_id desc
mapper.update: update research_issue set status=#{status},resolution=case when #{resolution}!='' then #{resolution} else resolution end,resolved_at=case when #{status}='RESOLVED' then now() else resolved_at end,closed_at=case when #{status}='CLOSED' then now() else closed_at end,update_by=#{username},version=version+1 where issue_id=#{issueId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from research_issue where project_id=#{projectId} and severity in ('HIGH','CRITICAL') and status not in ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')

select decision_id decisionId,decision_no decisionNo,title,context,decision,reason,decision_maker_user_id decisionMakerUserId,decided_at decidedAt from research_decision where project_id=#{projectId} order by decided_at desc

select change_id changeId,project_id projectId,change_no changeNo,title,reason,applicant_user_id applicantUserId,scope_impact scopeImpact,schedule_impact scheduleImpact,cost_impact costImpact,output_impact outputImpact,risk_impact riskImpact,status,submitted_at submittedAt,approved_at approvedAt,applied_at appliedAt from research_change_request where change_id=#{changeId}

select c.change_id changeId,c.change_no changeNo,c.title,c.reason,c.status,c.schedule_impact scheduleImpact,c.cost_impact costImpact,c.submitted_at submittedAt,c.approved_at approvedAt,c.applied_at appliedAt,u.nick_name applicantName from research_change_request c left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.project_id=#{projectId} order by c.change_id desc

select change_item_id changeItemId,change_type changeType,field_code fieldCode,before_value beforeValue,after_value afterValue,description from research_change_item where change_id=#{changeId} order by change_item_id
mapper.update: update research_change_request set status=#{status},submitted_at=case when #{status}='SUBMITTED' then now() else submitted_at end,approved_at=case when #{status}='APPROVED' then now() else approved_at end,rejected_at=case when #{status}='REJECTED' then now() else rejected_at end,applied_at=case when #{status}='APPLIED' then now() else applied_at end,update_by=#{username},version=version+1 where change_id=#{changeId}
mapper.insert: insert into research_budget_line(budget_id,category,planned_amount,description) select #{budgetId},category,amount,description from research_proposal_budget_line where proposal_id=#{proposalId}
insert into research_budget_line(budget_id,category,planned_amount,description) select #{toBudgetId},category,planned_amount,description from research_budget_line where budget_id=#{fromBudgetId}
mapper.update: update research_budget set status='SUPERSEDED' where project_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(version_no),0) from research_budget where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: update research_budget set baseline_id=#{baselineId} where budget_id=#{budgetId}
mapper.select: select budget_id budgetId,project_id projectId,baseline_id baselineId,version_no versionNo,total_amount totalAmount,status,effective_at effectiveAt from research_budget where project_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE' order by version_no desc limit 1
select budget_line_id budgetLineId,budget_id budgetId,category,planned_amount plannedAmount,description from research_budget_line where budget_id=#{budgetId} order by budget_line_id
select budget_line_id budgetLineId,budget_id budgetId,category,planned_amount plannedAmount,description from research_budget_line where budget_line_id=#{budgetLineId}

select e.expense_id expenseId,e.expense_no expenseNo,e.expense_date expenseDate,e.amount,e.description,e.reference_no referenceNo,b.category from research_expense e left join research_budget_line b on b.budget_line_id=e.budget_line_id where e.project_id=#{projectId} order by e.expense_date desc,e.expense_id desc
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from research_expense where project_id=#{projectId}
select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from research_expense where budget_line_id=#{budgetLineId}

select outcome_id outcomeId,expected_output_id expectedOutputId,outcome_type outcomeType,name,description,status,completed_date completedDate,external_reference externalReference from research_outcome where project_id=#{projectId} order by completed_date desc,outcome_id desc

select count(*) from research_expected_output eo join research_project p on p.proposal_id=eo.proposal_id where p.project_id=#{projectId} and (select count(*) from research_outcome o where o.project_id=#{projectId} and o.expected_output_id=eo.expected_output_id and o.status='COMPLETED') < eo.target_quantity

select document_id documentId,category,file_name fileName,storage_provider storageProvider,storage_key storageKey,mime_type mimeType,file_size fileSize,version_no versionNo,uploaded_by uploadedBy,uploaded_at uploadedAt from research_document where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and status='ACTIVE' order by uploaded_at desc
select count(*) from research_document where business_type='PROJECT' and business_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE'
select coalesce(max(version_no),0) from research_baseline where project_id=#{projectId}

select baseline_id baselineId,version_no versionNo,source_type sourceType,source_id sourceId,planned_start_date plannedStartDate,planned_end_date plannedEndDate,approved_budget approvedBudget,effective_at effectiveAt,status from research_baseline where project_id=#{projectId} order by version_no desc

select acceptance_id acceptanceId,acceptance_no acceptanceNo,project_summary projectSummary,completion_statement completionStatement,outstanding_items outstandingItems,applicant_user_id applicantUserId,status,submitted_at submittedAt,reviewed_at reviewedAt,review_comment reviewComment from research_acceptance where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: update research_acceptance set acceptance_no=#{acceptanceNo},project_summary=#{projectSummary},completion_statement=#{completionStatement},outstanding_items=#{outstandingItems},applicant_user_id=#{applicantUserId},status='SUBMITTED',submitted_at=now(),reviewed_at=null,review_comment=null where project_id=#{projectId} and status='RETURNED'
mapper.select: select closeout_id closeoutId,project_id projectId,acceptance_id acceptanceId,final_report_complete finalReportComplete,finance_complete financeComplete,outputs_complete outputsComplete,documents_complete documentsComplete,issues_complete issuesComplete,archive_complete archiveComplete,conclusion,status,completed_by completedBy,completed_at completedAt from research_closeout where project_id=#{projectId}
mapper.update: update research_workflow_instance set status=#{status},current_step=#{step},completed_at=case when #{status}='COMPLETED' then now() else completed_at end where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and status='RUNNING'
mapper.select: select workflow_id from research_workflow_instance where business_type=#{businessType} and business_id=#{businessId} and status='RUNNING' order by workflow_id desc limit 1

select a.action_id actionId,i.business_type businessType,i.business_id businessId,a.step_code stepCode,a.action,a.operator_user_id operatorUserId,u.nick_name operatorName,a.comment,a.acted_at actedAt from research_workflow_action a join research_workflow_instance i on i.workflow_id=a.workflow_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.operator_user_id where (i.business_type='CHANGE_REQUEST' and i.business_id in (select change_id from research_change_request where project_id=#{projectId})) or (i.business_type='ACCEPTANCE' and i.business_id in (select acceptance_id from research_acceptance where project_id=#{projectId})) or (i.business_type='PROPOSAL' and i.business_id=(select proposal_id from research_project where project_id=#{projectId})) order by a.acted_at desc

select p.proposal_id proposalId,p.proposal_no proposalNo,p.title,'PROPOSAL' businessType,p.status,u.nick_name applicantName,p.requested_budget requestedBudget,p.submitted_at submittedAt from research_proposal p left join sys_user u on u.user_id=p.applicant_user_id where p.status='UNDER_REVIEW' order by p.submitted_at

select c.change_id changeId,c.change_no changeNo,c.title,'CHANGE' businessType,c.status,p.project_id projectId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,u.nick_name applicantName,c.submitted_at submittedAt from research_change_request c join research_project p on p.project_id=c.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.applicant_user_id where c.status='SUBMITTED' order by c.submitted_at

select a.acceptance_id acceptanceId,a.acceptance_no acceptanceNo,'ACCEPTANCE' businessType,a.status,p.project_id projectId,p.project_no projectNo,p.project_name projectName,u.nick_name applicantName,a.submitted_at submittedAt from research_acceptance a join research_project p on p.project_id=a.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.applicant_user_id where a.status='SUBMITTED' order by a.submitted_at
